prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look. Interior room seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: "High Voltage", the crew's grungy-cosy underground nightclub in a converted warehouse. The large walkable area is a dark polished concrete and wooden plank floor reflecting pink, violet and cyan neon light, covering the whole middle and lower part of the image.
CENTER: a big square dance floor of glowing LED tiles in pink, cyan and violet (flat on the floor, walkable) - the most eye-catching spot.
TOP CENTER-LEFT, against the top wall: a low raised wooden stage with a karaoke microphone stand, two speaker stacks and a small presenter lectern at its side; a spotlight rig hangs above. TOP CENTER-RIGHT on the stage edge: a DJ booth with two turntables and a mixing desk glowing cyan.
TOP RIGHT on the top wall: a plain metal staff door with a small red light above it (to the back room).
TOP RIGHT CORNER: a worn red leather corner booth around a heavy round table with an arm-wrestling mat and ashtray (the "corner table"); next to it below a small round card table with scattered playing cards (no readable symbols).
LEFT EDGE: a long bar counter running vertically along the left wall, polished dark wood with a brass rail, a row of bar stools on the floor side, back shelves full of colourful glowing bottles, a beer tap; at the upper end of the bar a small round drink-mixing robot with tubes and a dome head; at the lower end a vintage cash register.
RIGHT SIDE: a few round bar tables with chairs along the right wall, string lights, a wall-mounted TV screen glowing (picture only, no text), a band tour poster with a lightning-skull motif (no letters), a cork board with pinned notes (no text).
RIGHT EDGE, lower part: a narrow metal staircase going UP through an opening in the right wall (staff stairs to the crew quarters), with a yellow-black striped railing.
BOTTOM: there is NO wall across the room - the main floor continues all the way down to the bottom edge. The main entrance is a padded double door in a short wall stub exactly at the bottom edge center, seen from inside, with a doormat on the floor in front of it. Along the bottom part of the main floor (on the same floor, freely walkable around them): BOTTOM LEFT a booth with a small table and an old glowing jukebox; BOTTOM RIGHT a battered velvet sofa and a long wooden table for crew breakfasts.
Small stuff at the edges: beer crates, cable runs drawn thin so they don't hide the floor, disco ball reflections as soft dots, a few neon tubes as abstract stripes on the walls.
EXITS clearly readable: BOTTOM edge center - the club's main double door to the street; TOP wall right - the staff door to the back office; RIGHT edge lower - the staff staircase going up.
Time: night, club lights on, empty before opening (no people).
